summary: Hakim's MENA startup program gives selected founders $6,000 in Hakim credits (equivalent to 6 months on the Business plan at $999/mo), early access to unreleased TTS/STT/voice-clone models, weekly technical office hours, and a direct Slack line to the engineering team. Eligibility is a MENA-based founding team, pre-seed to Series A (founded within 5 years, under $2M ARR if bootstrapped), under $10M raised. Decision within 5 working days, then a kickoff call and workspace enablement. Review exists for MENA founders; no card stated.
claim_steps: Fill the application form at tryhakim.ai/en/startups (name, work email, startup name, website, country, stage, team size, raised, use case, volume, timeline).
Expect a decision within 5 working days.
On approval: 30-minute technical kickoff call, then the Business plan is enabled on the workspace, early-access flag flipped, and a shared Slack channel created.
